claims.title: Molecular completion: retained product keys, local progression and authenticated output

quoted_fields.interface: Sixteen specified abiotic products, each requiring twenty ordered covalent growth operations, share the reagent environment. The target is at least 1 nmol authenticated correct product per program within 24 hours, at least 90% correct full sequences before selective salvage and at least 50% initiator yield. Ten cycles must retarget four libraries while preserving the stated functional stocks and useful output. Every coupling, physical clearance, hidden error, program/adaptor/enzyme stock, release, assay, preparation, waste and reset operation retains its actual cost and qualification boundary.
quoted_fields.failure: Simultaneous chemical rates, confinement, stock yields, photochemical behavior, aging, optical response and prices are introduced unless explicitly source-anchored. DNA-bond progression or an incorporated capture handle does not establish completion of the intended peptoid amide. Wrong strong bonds can pass retention; stalled chains remain in crude output. The fragment counterexample concerns pooled composition ladders, not all chromatography or mass spectrometry. A favorable parameter region is not a compatible material system. ROOT calculations require actual sensing and separation; held unread originals are not imported. No working twenty-step factory, qualified renewal, useful function, novelty or whole-service advantage is established.
